About

A small library of practical advice you can use the same day.

Why this site exists

Advice lists usually say what to do but not why. A tip is much easier to use when you know the reason behind it, so every tip here comes with one.

How a guide is put together

We pick a common situation, such as a job interview or running a small shop. Then we break it into numbered tips, each with a short reason and a small example. Questions people tend to ask next go in the FAQ at the end.

One clear actionEach tip tells you what to do.
The reasonA line on why it works, so you can adapt it.
A real exampleSomething you can copy and change.

A note on advice

These guides are general advice. Every workplace, customer and market is different, so treat the tips as a starting point and adjust them to your situation.

Short, practical advice with a reason and an example behind every tip.
